dct_title_s: Geodata of Damage Assessment of Kalam Area, Swat District, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province, Pakistan
dct_description_sm: This map illustrates satellite-detected potential damage in the Kalam area of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province, Pakistan. This area is located roughly 180 kilometers southeast of the 26 October 2015 earthquake epicenter. Using a Pléiades satellite image acquired 31 October 2015 and a WorldView-1 image acquired 05 November 2014, UNITAR ? UNOSAT identified 358 potentially damaged structures. The majority of these structures were situated in valley areas. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR - UNOSAT.
